mapName: A Major Bajor World - Car Meta

metas.name: American Samoa - Car Meta - Manu'a Car
metas.note: The front of a silver-grey truck with side mirrors can be seen on Manu’a and Olosega, which are connected by a bridge.

metas.name: American Samoa - Car Meta - Tau Car
metas.note: The front of a similar truck can be seen on the easternmost covered island of Tau. However, the truck will be glossy black, with side mirrors visible.

metas.name: American Samoa - Car Meta - Tutuila Car
metas.note:
A slightly rusted black truck bed can be seen on the main island of Tutuila.

This is the most common car that will be seen as it has the most coverage.

metas.name: Argentina - Car Meta - Sawdust Car Meta
metas.note: The “sawdust” car is found in centre-south Argentina and has a unique sandy dust on its visible black back.

metas.name: Australia - Car Meta - Open Trunk Meta
metas.note: The town of Gascoyne Junction in Western Australia is distinct, as the driver left the car boot open while covering this town, creating a very unique car meta.

metas.name: Australia - Car Meta - Snorkel Car
metas.note:
Australia is home to dozens of rare Google cars, which can usually be found in natural reserves.

Most rare Google cars with snorkels are located in New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. The only snorkel cars outside of NSW are in the northwestern part of Wunaamin Conservation Area (northern WA) and along Lucky Bay (south coastal WA).

metas.name: Australia - Car Meta - Wire Car Meta
metas.note: On most of the Northern Territory section of the Barkly Highway and a small part of the Queensland section, a wire can be seen on the left side of the car.

metas.name: Brazil - Car Meta - Noronha Car Meta
metas.note: Ilha de Fernando de Noronha is covered by a white buggy which sometimes has a visible front.

metas.name: Car Meta - 2 Zipties
metas.note: 2 clearly visible zip-ties can be found on a few roads in the southwest. Notably most of the 39 and its many sideroads, southeast of Ubar, southern 43, and the westernmost roads.
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & The Oman Meta by @samuel8170

metas.name: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera
metas.note:
An antenna that is facing towards the camera is found all over the north.

Note by MB: This antenna can further be divided by the wire on the left side of the truck. BUT: If you're playing NMPZ and can't see the wire, it's still worth knowing where this antenna is found in general.
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & The Oman Meta by @samuel8170

metas.name: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera - Big Wire Loop
metas.note:
The backwards-facing antenna can be further divided into smaller areas based on the type of wire present on the bar.

A wire that loops around the bar is found around Al Suwayq.
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & The Oman Meta by @samuel8170

metas.name: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera - No Car
metas.note:
The backwards-facing antenna can be further divided into smaller areas based on the type of wire present on the bar.

If the car is mostly or entirely blurred, you are in

  • North Al Buraymi
  • North Al Dhahirah
  • South of Al Suwayq

metas.name: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera - No Wire
metas.note:
The backwards-facing antenna can be further divided into smaller areas based on the type of wire present on the bar.

No wire at all is found in the northwest.
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & The Oman Meta by @samuel8170

metas.name: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera - Small Wire Loop
metas.note:
The backwards-facing antenna can be further divided into smaller areas based on the type of wire present on the bar.

A small looping wire in front of the bar is mainly in the east, starting in Muscat and Ad Dhakiliyah
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & The Oman Meta by @samuel8170

metas.name: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera - Wire on Bar
metas.note:
The backwards-facing antenna can be further divided into smaller areas based on the type of wire present on the bar.

A wire following the bar is found on the roads that make an A-shape on the map, and on the Al Batinah/Al Dhahirah border.
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & The Oman Meta by @samuel8170

metas.name: Car Meta - Coiled Cable - Flat
metas.note:
Coiled Cable can be found in Coastal Al Batinah South, and in North Eastern Ash Sharqiyah South.

The cable can have several shapes but remains easy to identify.

Al Batinah South is very flat and more residential
metas.footer: Source: Oman Cable Guide by capitalos15

metas.name: Car Meta - Coiled Cable - Mountainous
metas.note:
Coiled Cable can be found in Coastal Al Batinah South, and in North Eastern Ash Sharqiyah South.

The cable can have several shapes but remains easy to identify.

Ash Sharqiyah South is more mountainous or flat with distant mountains
metas.footer: Source: Oman Cable Guide by capitalos15

metas.name: Car Meta - Double Laying Antenna
metas.note: Mostly found at the same places as single laying antenna but sometimes on different (sections of) roads.

metas.name: Car Meta - Forward Facing Antenna
metas.note: A forwards-facing antenna is only found in and around Muscat.
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & The Oman Meta by @samuel8170

metas.name: Car Meta - Full Blurred Car
metas.note:
You might still be able to kind off make out the colour but there shouldn’t be any parts of the car fully visible except for (usually) the antenna.

In the North, it can be found West of Muscat. In the South, it can be found on the 31 in Al Wusta, on the 45 & 47 and around Salalah.

metas.name: Car Meta - Gen 3; Red Car; Long Antenna
metas.note: A red Generation 3 car with a long antenna can be seen in and east of Melbourne.

metas.name: Car Meta - Left Cut Ziptie
metas.note:
There are two visible zip ties, but the left one is cut.

Cannot be found in Musandam, Muscat, Al Dhahirah, Al Batinah South. In Al Buraimi, it's only found North of Al Ain. In Al Batinah North, it's only found in the eastern half.

metas.name: Car Meta - No Right Ziptie, Wire behind Bar
metas.note:
No right zip tie but the wire is arranged differently so that it passes behind the back of the metal bar.

Can be found West of Muscat.

metas.name: Car Meta - Right Tilted Antenna
metas.note: An antenna bent to the right is found all over the south, as well as a few pockets in the north, notably northeast of El Ain, west of Al Suwayq, and around Bidiyah.
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & The Oman Meta by @samuel8170

metas.name: Car Meta - Semi-Blurred Car
metas.note:
Less blurred than the normal blurred. Parts of the car are still fully visible, usually the front but sometimes the sides too.

It can be found around Muscat.

metas.name: Car Meta - Straight Antenna
metas.note: A regular-looking antenna that faces upwards is mainly found around and west of Muscat, as well as on highways in the northwest. A few other pockets include Al Buraimi and Sohar.
metas.footer: Source: PlonkIt & The Oman Meta by @samuel8170

metas.name: Chile - Car Meta - Conguillo National Park
metas.note: Conguillio National Park can be recognized by this white truck with visible side mirrors and an antenna on the front right.

metas.name: Chile - Car Meta - Puerto Williams
metas.note:
Puerto Williams, the southernmost town covered by street view, can be recognized by this white pickup truck with visible side mirrors.

NOTE: The Puerto Williams coverage is located fairly far away from the normal car coverage in Chile. The nearest normal car coverage is in Fuerte Bulnes, near Punta Arenas.

metas.name: Chile - Car Meta - Toyota Hilux
metas.note: A grey Toyota Hilux, with various gear loaded and a snorkel on the front right, can be seen from around Baños Morales.

metas.name: Chile - Car Meta - Trailer
metas.note: The Google car can be seen towing a white and silver trailer with the word ‘Outback’ north of the Chilean National Zoo in Santiago.

metas.name: Colombia - Car Meta - Gen 3 - white/blue striped car
metas.note: Gen 3 with the white-blue car follows a straight line between Cartagena and Medellín, has partial coverage along Route 80 west of Bosconia, as well as along Route 45 north of Bucaramanga and east of Medellín.
metas.footer: Source: A Learnable Colombia by Timo

metas.name: Colombia - Car Meta - Gen 4 - Grey Car
metas.note: Gen 4 coverage with the grey car is not found north of Montería, has a gap between Bucaramanga and Bogotá, forms a 'staircase' pattern with right angles at Medellín and Bogotá, covers areas around Bucaramanga, and has a missing section around Popayán.
metas.footer: Source: A Learnable Colombia by Timo

metas.name: Colombia - Car Meta - Gen 4 - White Car
metas.note: Gen 4 with the white car has no coverage south of Cali, very little around Medellín, and forms a curved pattern around Medellín.
metas.footer: Source: A Learnable Colombia by Timo

metas.name: Colombia - Car Meta - Leticia
metas.note:
This unique vehicle can be found in and around Leticia, the Southernmost town in Colombia.

NOTE: The long concrete blocks seen in the bottom left corner are a reliable way of recognising the road North of Leticia.

metas.name: Colombia - Car Meta - Providencia
metas.note: The island of Providencia, located roughly 90 kilometres North of San Andrés, is home to this unique grey truck.

metas.name: Colombia - Car Meta - San Andres
metas.note: Coverage on the Caribbean island of San Andrés was taken by this distinct white car.

metas.name: France - Car Meta - Rare Antenna - Black & White
metas.note:
On rare occasions, you may find a flag attached to the antenna in the generation 3 coverage. While much of the highlighted areas has been overwritten, learning the distribution of each antenna can yield very high scores.

The black/white flag can be found in Calvados, Orne, Eastern Bourgogne and Loire/Haut de Loire

metas.name: France - Car Meta - Rare Antenna - Blue
metas.note:
On rare occasions, you may find a flag attached to the antenna in the generation 3 coverage. While much of the highlighted areas has been overwritten, learning the distribution of each antenna can yield very high scores.

The blue flag can be found in Bas-Rhin, Aube and the Correze/Haute-Vienne/Dordogne Tristate

metas.name: France - Car Meta - Rare Antenna - Red
metas.note:
On rare occasions, you may find a flag attached to the antenna in the generation 3 coverage. While much of the highlighted areas has been overwritten, learning the distribution of each antenna can yield very high scores.

The red flag can be found in the eastern part of the Nord-Department

metas.name: Germany - Car Meta - Gen 3 / Antenna
metas.note: This rare Generation 3 car coverage with an antenna can be found in central Hamburg (Speicherstadt). Note by MB: This is officially a trekker, so you won't find any copyright.

metas.name: Germany - Car Meta - Gen 3 Black Car
metas.note:
You can find a Generation 3 black car in this safari park southeast of Bielefeld.

You can commonly see 4x4s painted with a zebra pattern in the park.

NOTE: This car is unique to this park within all of Europe.

metas.name: Germany - Car Meta - White/Black Gen 4 Car
metas.note:
You can find this rare white and black Generation 4 car in Hamburg and around Frankfurt.

NOTE: You can also find the same car around London and in Ireland.

metas.name: Hawaii - Car Meta - Stubby Antenna
metas.note: This antenna can be found anywhere, but is most common Hawaii Island, then Kauai, then Oahu.
metas.footer: Source: Geoguessr Guide to Hawaii by pianoman

metas.name: Iceland - Car Meta - Red Truck
metas.note:
Iceland can be split in half depending on the colour of the pickup truck, with red being found in the southwest, and white being found in the northeast.

The Red Truck is found between Sudurland and Vesturland

metas.name: Iceland - Car Meta - White Truck
metas.note: Iceland can be split in half depending on the colour of the pickup truck, with red being found in the southwest, and white being found in the northeast.

metas.name: India - Car - Kuno National Park Car
metas.note: This car has a back curving bar, but is mostly blurred. It can be found east of Kuno National Park
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Andaman Car
metas.note: This is the most common, though not only car on Andaman.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Arunachal Pradesh - Back Antenna
metas.note: Within Arunachal Pradesh, a back antenna can be found around Chowkam and East of Namsai.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Arunachal Pradesh - White Car with Mirrors
metas.note: Within Arunachal Pradesh, a white car with mirrors can be found on the road west of Itanagar.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Assam - Back Antenna
metas.note: If you see a back antenna in Assam, you're in the far east of the state.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Black Car
metas.note: This is not something you will come across very often, but if you have a black car and don’t really know where to go/want to confirm your guess, black car is more common in Telangana/Andhra Pradesh, especially in Northern Telangana and Coastal AP.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Black Goa Car
metas.note: This black car, uniquely characterized through the black bars on each the side, is only found in Goa.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Boxy Car
metas.note: Large visible, square shaped cars can be found in all states northwest of Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh, except for Madhya Pradesh. It can also be found in and around Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Boxy Car - 5 Indents
metas.note: A boxy car with 5 indents can be found near the river mouth of the Subarnarekha river near the Odisha/WB border.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Boxy Car - 6 Indents
metas.note: A boxy car with 6 indents is found near Malkangiri, Odisha.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Boxy Car - Karnataka
metas.note: Boxy car in Karnataka is only found in and around Bengaluru.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Boxy Car - Odisha
metas.note: A boxy car with an extra step at the front is found in Odisha.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Flower Car
metas.note: A car with flowers on the front can be found around Keonjhar, on the 49 and the 20.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Goa/Daman Car
metas.note: This car (note the antenna!) can be found in Goa, and in the Union Territory of Daman.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Haryal Car
metas.note: This car is unique to Haryal, PB. It looks similar to the boxy car, but with a rounded front.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Himachal Pradesh - Boxy Car
metas.note: Shimla is the only city in Himachal Pradesh to have a boxy car, which is this car with the top right corner visible with a thread (sometimes not visible).
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Jammu/Kashmir Car
metas.note:
White car, box car with bars and the central strap leaning right.

It can be found mainly in Jammu/Kashmir but sometimes in Sultanpur, UP.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Ladakh Car
metas.note: All roads in Ladakh have this white car with visible front.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Adidas Car
metas.note:
The "Adidas Car" is characterized by the black stripes on the white car front. Sometimes it has a visible side mirror. It also often has a visible bar at the back.

It is exclusive to the island of Amini

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Big Blur
metas.note: A big circular blur (either full blurred or transparently blurred) is very common in Retrocam. On Lakshadweep, however, it is only found on Andrott and Kalpeni (both also have a car that's unique for these islands respectively).
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Blurred Black Front
metas.note:
This car with the subtle black blur at the front is found in Kalpeni. The blur can be very subtle sometimes, and is confusable with the blurred white edges on Agatti.

Sometimes the same car has a slightly different blur, where the edges are exposed.

Kalpeni can also have a big circular blur, so don't rule out Kalpeni if you don't see this car.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Blurred White Edges
metas.note: This car is mostly blurred and has subtle white edges at the front. It's found on the island of Agatti. Sometimes the edges are so subtle that you can overlook them and confuse it with the Kalpeni car (which has a subtle black blur)

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Exposed Black
metas.note: This car with an exposed black front is unique to Kiltan. Note that the front is always exposed on Kiltan, if it's blurred (even partly), it's not the Kiltan car.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Red Car
metas.note:
The red front blur can be found on Andrott. Sometimes, the same car has a bit different blur, where there's some exposed red visible.

Note that Andrott can also have the big circular blur where you see no car.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - White Car with Mirror
metas.note: This car is the most likely to encounter if you get Lakshadweep. It has a white front and always a bit of mirror visible on the left. Sometimes a part of the mirror is blurred, but you can always see at least a bit of it exposed. This car is so common because it's on the main island of Lakshadweep, Kavaratti.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - White Exposed Front
metas.note: This car with an exposed white front is found of Kadmat. This car can be confused with others: It's not the Kadmat car if it has a visible side mirror. It's also not the Kadmat car if the front is blurred.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Mechuka Car
metas.note: Mechuka features a unique car in Arunachal. It can be found in the valley and on the road leading to it from Along on the NH13.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Mizoram - Double Mirror Car
metas.note: In Mizoram, a grey car with double mirrors appears in the southernmost coverage, near the NH502.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Mizoram - Long Antenna
metas.note:
If you see a long antenna, combined with a black car front in Mizoram, you're on the NH6 north of Serkhan.

Keep in mind this car is not unique to Mizoram.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Mizoram - Stubby Antenna
metas.note: A car with a black front and a stubby antenna within Mizoram can be found on the roads west of Aizawi.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - NH179B Car
metas.note: This car has an antenna with some kind of a spring. It basically goes from Salem to Chennai.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Open Trunk
metas.note: In the eastern parts of Ajmer, RJ, you can sometimes see an open trunk in Smallcam. It can be found north of Shrinagar/west of Circular Rd.
metas.footer: Discovered by TheRealWoly, shared on GeoGuessr India Discord, extent researched by Major Bajor.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Orange Flag Car
metas.note: A car with an orange flag can be found in the Jharkhand north-east panhandle.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Punjab - Black Boxy Car
metas.note: Within Punjab, the black boxy car can be found on the Pakistani border between Firozpur and Amritsar.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Punjab - Dasuya Forest Car
metas.note: Within Punjab, this car is is unique to Dasuya Forest. Beware that this car is not unique to Punjab though.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Punjab - Red Boxy Car
metas.note: Within Punjab, the red boxy car can be found in Ludhiana, Chandigarh, and a bit north between them. The coverage forms a reverse 'v'.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Racecar
metas.note: This cool car with a spoiler at the back can be found in Max-North Andaman, near Daglipur.

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Rewa Car
metas.note: This car has a back curving bar at the front and white bars on the side. It's found mostly around Rewa, but also around Raipura.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Roing Car
metas.note: Within Arunachal Pradesh, both this black and this red car are exclusively found in Roing. The black car appears mainly on the NH313 and east. The red car appears mainly west of the main road.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh; self-researched

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Satpura National Park Car
metas.note: This car has a back-curving bar and a singular black bar. It's found mainly east of Satpura National Park, and sometimes around Raipura.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Tezu-Lohitpur Road
metas.note: If you see this white, boxy-looking car in Arunachal Pradesh, you're on the road between Tezu and Lohitpur.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Western Meghalaya Antenna
metas.note: In the very far western part of the Meghalaya, on the roads north of Purakhasia, you can find a particular car with an antenna on the top left. It can be quite hard to see so be aware it exists so you know what to look for
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - White Goa Car with bar
metas.note: This white car, uniquely characterized through the bar on the side, which is black and grey, is only found in Goa.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Car Meta - Yellow Car
metas.note:
While the car is blurred most of the time, Sikkim features a noticeable car that gives the western part of Sikkim, starting at Rangpo.

It can have an antenna, be blurred, almost invisible, but as long as you see a yellow car, you know it’s here.
metas.footer: Source: India region guessing doc by bzhbzhbzh

metas.name: India - Misc - India Union Muslim League
metas.note:
Green flag with half moon and star, pointing at the top left corner.

This party is almost exclusively active in Kerala. Mostly in the districts of Kozhikode and Malappuram.
metas.footer: Source: Indian Flag Metas by Atomo MC

metas.name: Indonesia - Car Meta - Gen 3 Antenna
metas.note: Generation 3 antenna coverage is most commonly found on Java, but can very rarely be seen on Bali in and around Denpasar. It is most commonly seen in East Java, as most of the antenna coverage in the west has been overwritten by Generation 4.

metas.name: Indonesia - Car Meta - Gen 3 Black
metas.note: Black Generation 3 coverage can be found almost everywhere in Indonesia, but is most common in Sulawesi.

metas.name: Indonesia - Car Meta - Jagasatru Car
metas.note: A black cab with men sitting in the truck bed can be seen near Jagasatru on Bali.

metas.name: Indonesia - Car Meta - Wooden Plank Car
metas.note: A white SUV with black bars and a wooden plank on the roof can rarely be seen in eastern Bali.

metas.name: Mexico - Car Meta - Cofre de Perote Truck
metas.note: This white truck with visible rearview mirrors can be seen in the Cofre de Perote national park.

metas.name: Mexico - Car Meta - La Malinche Car
metas.note: This Street View car with a yellow hood can be found by the La Malinche volcano in Tlaxcala.

metas.name: Mexico - Car Meta - La Seca Car
metas.note: This red Street View car with a black roof can be found in the town of La Seca in Sinaloa.

metas.name: Peru - Car Meta - White Truck
metas.note: Within Peru, this white Street View car is found in central Cusco. It drives from the remote town of Aguas Calientes up to Machu Picchu.

metas.name: Philippines - Car Meta - General Santos Car
metas.note: You may find this black Street View car with a visible roof rack in and around the city of General Santos.

metas.name: Philippines - Car Meta - Mayon Vehicle
metas.note: This vehicle with several thick black bars can be found just south of the Mayon Volcano.

metas.name: Philippines - Car Meta - Orange Car
metas.note: An orange Street View car with visible side mirrors can be found on Corregidor Island.

metas.name: Philippines - Car Meta - Taped Car back
metas.note: In northwestern Bohol you can find this Street View car with tape on the back.

metas.name: South Africa - Car Meta - Kruger National Park Car
metas.note:
A camouflage car with black side mirrors and roof racks can be seen in Kruger National Park, on the Mozambique border.

NOTE: The Park now also has generation 4 coverage.

metas.name: Turkey - Car Meta - Truck Coverage
metas.note: Generation 4 truck coverage is mainly found in the far east of the country and along the southern coast, with smaller pockets in the west and around Kastamonu.

metas.name: United States - Car Meta - Daniel Boone Car
metas.note:
This section of road in Daniel Boone National Forest near Beattyville, KY has a unique Google car.

Note by MB: This coverage is overwritten afaik.
metas.footer: Source: A Unique USA by mistystar

metas.name: United States - Car Meta - Ford Bronco
metas.note:
As part of a promotional campaign, the TransAmerica Trail from Oregon to North Carolina was covered by a Ford Bronco. The car can recognised by its unblurred black roof and red hood, and is mostly found on unpaved rural roads.

Looking backwards, you will see two other Ford SUVs escorting the camera car.

metas.name: United States - Car Meta - Golden Gate Car
metas.note: This car can be found to the north of the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco.
metas.footer: Source: A Unique USA by mistystar

metas.name: United States - Car Meta - Santa Catalina Car
metas.note: This island to the south of Los Angeles has a unique Google car.
metas.footer: Source: A Unique USA by mistystar
